scoringPolicy: Fixed 90 selected bundles. Entire selected proposition must be correctly bound and qualified with evidence for CORRECT_RESOLVED; any contradictory resolved assertion is WRONG_RESOLVED; otherwise missing/partial is MISSED_DEFENSIBLE_RESOLUTION. Expected abstentions require no positive guessed edge. Exact offsets measured separately. Ambiguous adjudications documented, denominator never changed.
independenceLimitation: Same assistant authors corpus and evaluates outputs, with prior knowledge of engine. No external evaluator independence. Expected written before any NLP or binder inference.
